# three.js 0.160.0

The parts of [three.js](https://threejs.org) the viewer uses, unchanged, at
their paths in the npm package `three@0.160.0`
(`https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.160.0.tgz`, integrity
`sha512-DLU8lc0zNIPkM7rH5/e1Ks1Z8tWCGRq6g8mPowdDJpw1CFBJMU7UoJjC6PefXW7z//SSl0b2+GCw14LB+uDhng==`).
MIT licensed; see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

`scripts/build_single.py` builds them into `step-loupe.html` through the
import map in `src/index.html`. To move to another release, replace this
folder with the same files from that release and update the import map's paths.
